title: HVAC Maintenance Agreements Held by One Customer
content:
A customer may hold any number of HVAC Maintenance Agreements, one per property. No maximum number of agreements applies to a single customer; the limit is set per property.

The per-property limit, and how an agreement combines with a homeowner service contract, are governed by the HVAC Maintenance Agreements rule on one agreement per property and the warranty holder discount.

## Points of judgement

| Question | Answer under this rule |
|---|---|
| Is there a ceiling on how many agreements one customer holds? | No. The number of agreements per customer is unlimited. |
| What unit does each agreement attach to? | One property. |
| Does an agreement the customer holds on one property count against an agreement on a different property? | No; agreements are counted per property, and no per-customer maximum exists. |

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical customer who owns a home and two rental houses at three different addresses may hold three Bridgewell Comfort Care agreements, one on each property.
